description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale with tick marks from 20 to 100 at intervals of 20. The plot utilizes dual y-axes; the left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" with a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 and a tick interval of 0.1, while the right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100 and a tick interval of 10. Four lines are displayed on the graph. The "Perplexity" data is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, corresponding to the left y-axis. It begins at a peak of approximately 4.59 at an x-value of 10, declines steadily to 4.3 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, dips to a low of 4.29 at x=70, and then increases to end at approximately 4.38 at x=100. A dashed dark red line without markers, labeled "Full Cache PPL," runs horizontally across the plot at a constant perplexity value of approximately 4.38 on the left y-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponding to the right y-axis. It starts at approximately 40% at x=10, exhibits a gradual increase to roughly 48% at x=70, rises to 55% at x=80, spikes sharply to approximately 98% at x=90, and ends at 100% at x=100. Finally, a dashed blue line without markers, labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem.," forms a horizontal line at a constant value of 100% on the right y-axis.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio, evaluated using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. The x-axis is labeled 'Recent Sequence Ratio (%)' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and the left y-axis is labeled 'Perplexity' with a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7. The right y-axis is labeled 'GPU Mem. Ratio (%)' with a linear scale from 40 to 100. The orange line, representing perplexity, begins at approximately 4.6 at 5% recent sequence ratio, decreases steadily to 4.2 at 40%, and then stabilizes before increasing slightly to 4.3 at 100%. The blue line, representing GPU memory ratio, starts at 40% at 5% recent sequence ratio and increases linearly to 80% at 100%. Two horizontal reference lines are included: a red dashed line at a perplexity of 4.4 labeled 'Full Cache PPL,' and a blue dashed line at a GPU memory ratio of 100% labeled 'Full Cache GPU Mem.' The legend is positioned at the top center of the plot.
